      How evaluation works

      • LLM evaluation (primary): an LLM reads each fetched job description against the candidate's full resume profile and scores semantic fit 0–10, with a recommendation (Apply / Review / Skip), strengths, and concerns. This is the ranking to trust.
      • Deterministic pre-filter (secondary): title-based keyword scoring (Seniority + Domain fit + Location + Differentiators, minus a dev-lean penalty) is used to decide which ~25 roles get fetched and LLM-evaluated, and remains as a reference below.
      • Excluded per instruction: "Software Development Manager", "Development Manager", hands-on dev-team leadership, and Vice President / C-level roles. US-only "remote" postings were dropped.
      • Non-GTA roles that require in-office days are flagged and capped below 8.0 (max 7.9) — you cannot travel 50+ km to an office.
